partners.mechanism_chain: ITGA2B (HGNC:5671) —DISRUPTS→ Integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 signaling pathway (P00511); ITGB3 (HGNC:5675) —DISRUPTS→ Integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 signaling pathway (P00511); Integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 signaling pathway (P00511) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal platelet aggregation (HP:0001900); Abnormal platelet aggregation (HP:0001900) —LEADS_TO→ Bleeding (HP:0011411); ITGA2B (HGNC:5671) —LEADS_TO→ Thrombasthenia (HP:0001900); ITGB3 (HGNC:5675) —LEADS_TO→ Thrombasthenia (HP:0001900). Mutations in ITGA2B (encoding integrin alpha-IIb) and ITGB3 (encoding integrin beta-3) disrupt the formation and function of the integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 complex. This complex is essential for platelet aggregation, and its dysfunction leads to abnormal platelet aggregation (HP:0001900), resulting in bleeding tendencies (HP:0011411) and Thrombasthenia (HP:0001900) in Glanzmann thrombasthenia. It is hypothesized that MONDO:0013016, given its shared causal genes, also results from loss-of-function mutations in these genes, leading to a similar disruption of the integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 signaling pathway and consequently abnormal platelet aggregation and bleeding.

#### 1. Glanzmann thrombasthenia  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.485)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-114608)

**Proposed mechanism:** ITGA2B (HGNC:5671) —DISRUPTS→ Integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 signaling pathway (P00511); ITGB3 (HGNC:5675) —DISRUPTS→ Integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 signaling pathway (P00511); Integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 signaling pathway (P00511) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal platelet aggregation (HP:0001900); Abnormal platelet aggregation (HP:0001900) —LEADS_TO→ Bleeding (HP:0011411); ITGA2B (HGNC:5671) —LEADS_TO→ Thrombasthenia (HP:0001900); ITGB3 (HGNC:5675) —LEADS_TO→ Thrombasthenia (HP:0001900). Mutations in ITGA2B (encoding integrin alpha-IIb) and ITGB3 (encoding integrin beta-3) disrupt the formation and function of the integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 complex. This complex is essential for platelet aggregation, and its dysfunction leads to abnormal platelet aggregation (HP:0001900), resulting in bleeding tendencies (HP:0011411) and Thrombasthenia (HP:0001900) in Glanzmann thrombasthenia. It is hypothesized that MONDO:0013016, given its shared causal genes, also results from loss-of-function mutations in these genes, leading to a similar disruption of the integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 signaling pathway and consequently abnormal platelet aggregation and bleeding.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of a distinct causal gene for MONDO:0013016 that is not ITGA2B or ITGB3, or demonstration that the functional consequence of mutations in ITGA2B or ITGB3 for MONDO:0013016 is gain-of-function rather than loss-of-function. _(variant: A common pathogenic variant (AF > 0.01) in ITGA2B or ITGB3 associated with MONDO:0013016 would falsify the hypothesis of these genes being solely responsible for rare disease phenotypes.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanism involving the integrin alpha-IIb/beta-3 complex can inform the development of targeted therapies for bleeding disorders, potentially benefiting patients with both Glanzmann thrombasthenia and other related inherited platelet disorders like MONDO:0013016.
